source_record_notes: Only names and hashes of selected package records are retained; raw records and source paths are excluded.

validation.method: Binary STL record length, finite vertices and normals, exact float32 vertex sharing; Trimesh topology and signed volume; SHA match to selected source; bounds and published manifest dimensions.
validation.units_note: STL does not encode units. mm is declared by the selected source manifests; measured extents are checked against those manifests when supplied.
validation.scope_limit: Does not prove self-intersection absence, printer/slicer suitability, assembled fit, continuous-motion clearance, or material strength.

physical_assembly: Actual installed revision per part unknown. The user reports completed printing but this catalog does not certify fit or strength.
